result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the two prior blocking findings, the implementor response, and directly touched production/test surfaces. The new code adds a real PI extension registration path, a project-local extension entrypoint, live `message_end` routing into capture, and runtime-note routing for relevant session/turn lifecycle events. Required story and epic gates were rerun.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by `src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:212-276`, which exports `registerContextStewardExtension`, registers `pi.on("message_end", ...)`, opens/creates the managed thread, and routes events through `capturePiEvent`/`captureFinalizedActivity`. The project entrypoint exists at `.pi/extensions/context-steward.ts:1` and re-exports the default extension implementation. Production-handler tests at `tests/context-steward/capture-service.test.ts:551-608` prove registered handlers capture live prompt, response, and tool-result `message_end` events with source order and target metadata.

Resolved by `src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:79-138`, which maps `session_start`, `session_before_switch`, `session_shutdown`, `turn_start`, and `turn_end` to `createPiRuntimeNoteActivity`, and by registered handlers at `src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:251-269`. The production-handler test at `tests/context-steward/capture-service.test.ts:647-701` verifies these lifecycle events persist as runtime-event messages with runtime-note parts.

openQuestions: Live dogfooding should still confirm whether PI exposes a stronger stable live `message_end` identifier than the current response/tool/fingerprint fallback; this is already tracked as a design open question and is not blocking Story 2 readiness.
additionalObservations: `npm run verify` passed with 47 unit tests, including the new registered-handler coverage for production PI capture paths.
`npm run verify-all` passed; its integration phase reports `No integration tests found`, so the epic gate currently adds no integration-test signal beyond the passing unit/typecheck gate.

No material fake adapter, placeholder branch, or non-real runtime path was found in the reviewed production capture path. The injectable `createStore` option is used by tests while the default production path creates a real `FileThreadStore` under the PI context cwd.
